correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the exact Peaceman–Rachford tensor factorization, the tridiagonal determinant recurrence, an explicit inverse-entry formula, endpoint minimality of the resolvent diagonal, strict monotonicity in the timestep parameter, and the limiting fixed point. Necessity and sufficiency in two dimensions follow from the sign structure of the Kronecker factors. The \(2\times2\) counterexample is exact rational arithmetic, and the included checker reproduces it. No finite experiment is used as proof of the infinite sequence limit.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a sharp, mesh-size-dependent boundary for a classical unconditionally stable ADI method to preserve the natural nonnegative cone. It distinguishes stability from a discrete maximum-principle property, reduces an apparently \(mn\)-dimensional sign test to two scalar determinant thresholds, gives a computable exact rule for every rectangular grid, and identifies the asymptotic square-grid constant \(4-2\sqrt2\). The exact negative witness immediately above the small-grid frontier makes the boundary operational rather than merely qualitative.
